m: परि-√ राज् P. Ā. -राजति, ˚ते, to shine on all sides, spread radiance everywhere, R.
परि-राप् (Padap. -रप्) m. pl. (√ रप्) crying or talking all around, N. of a class of demons, RV.
परि-रापिन् mfn. whispering to, talking over, persuading, AV.
परि-राटक (Pāṇ. iii, 2, 146).

v: tri॰ pari + rawa--tAcCIlye GinuR । samantAd rawanaSIle striyAM NIp ।
m: परि-राटिन् (142) mfn. crying aloud, screaming.
परि-√ रभ् Ā. -रभते (pf. 3. pl. -रेभिरे; fut. -रप्स्यते; ind.p. -रभ्य; inf. -रब्धुम्), to embrace, clasp, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Desid. -रिप्सते, to wish or try to embrace, Ragh.; Prab.
a: परिरभ् — {c1c} A. To embrace, clasp; परिरभ्य वक्षसा Ku. 5. 3; इत्युक्तवंतं परिरभ्य दोर्भ्यों Ki. 11. 80; Bv. 1. 95; Śi. 9. 72.
परि(री)रंभः, --परिरंभणं — Embracing, an embrace; द्रुतपरिरंभनिपीडनक्षमत्वं Śi. 1. 74, 10. 52; U. 1. 24, 27; किं पुरेव ससंभ्रमं परिरंभणं न ददासि Gīt. 3.

m: परि-रथ्या (आ), f. id., MBh.
a street, road, A.
परि-रथ्य n. a partic. part of a chariot, AV.
परि-रब्ध mfn. one who has embraced, R.
encircled, embraced, BhP.

परि-√ रक्ष् P. -रक्षति (ep. also ˚ते; inf. -रक्षितुम्), to guard well or completely, rescue, save, defend from (abl.), RV. &c. &c.; to keep, conceal, keep secret, Mn.; MBh. &c.; to protect, rule, govern (acc.), R.; to avoid, shun, Suśr.; (Ā.) to get out of a person's (gen.) way, R.
a: परिरक्ष् — {c1c} P. 1 To protect, save. --2 To govern, restrain. --3 To conceal, hide.

m: परि-रक्षा f. keeping, guarding, protection, Mn. v, 94 &c.
परि-रक्षणीय mfn. to be completely protected or preserved, Pañc.; Prasannar.
परि-रक्षण mf(ई)n. guarding, protecting, a protector, Hariv.
परि-रक्षण n. the act of guarding, defending, preserving, keeping, maintaining
protection, rescue, deliverance, Mn.; MBh. &c.
care, caution, Suśr.
a: परिरक्षणं, --परिरक्षा — 1 Protection, preservation, guarding; Ms. 5. 94, 7. {2} --2 Keeping, maintaining, adhering to; न समयपरिरक्षणं क्षमं ते Ki. 1. 45. --3 Deliverance, rescuing. --4 Care, caution.

m: परि-रक्षक m. a guardian, protector, L.
परि-रक्षिन् mfn. (ifc.) guarding, protecting, MBh.
परि-रक्षित mfn. well guarded or preserved or kept, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
परि-रक्षितव्य mfn. to be guarded, to be kept secret, MBh.
परि-रक्षितृ mfn. keeping, protecting, a protector, defender, MBh.; R.
परि-रक्षितिन् g. इष्टादि.
a: परिरक्षितिन्, परिरक्षितृ, परिरक्षिन् — a. Protecting, a protector, defender.

m: परि-रक्ष्य mfn. = ˚रक्षितव्य, MBh.; R.
परि-√ रम् P. -रमति (Pāṇ. i, 3, 83), to take pleasure in, be delighted with (abl.), Bhaṭṭ.

s: puM, (pariramByate iti । pari + raBi + GaY । “raBeraSabliwoH .” 7 । 1 । 63 । iti num .) AliNganam । ityamaraH । 3 । 2 । 30 ॥ (yaTA, gItagovinde । 5 । 7 । “DyAyaMstvAmaniSaM japannapi tavEvAlApamantrAvalIM mUyastvatkucakumBanirBaraparIramBAmftaM vAYCati ॥”)
v: pu॰ pari + raBa--GaY mum ca vA dIrGaH । AliNgane ।
m: परि-रम्भ m. (cf. परीर्˚), embracing, an embrace, Kāv.

k.v: संवीक्षणं विचयनं मार्गणं मृगणा मृगः। परिरम्भः परिष्वङ्गः संश्लेष उपगूहनम्.।

m: परि-रम्भण n. embracing, an embrace, Kāv.
परि-रम्भिन् mfn. (ifc.) clasped, girt by, ib.
embracing, Śiś.
परि-रम्भित mfn. (fr. Caus.) embraced, quite occupied with or engrossed by (comp.), BhP.
परि-रमित mfn. (fr. Caus.) delighted (by amorous sport), Chandom.
परि-रन्धित mfn. (√ रध्, Caus.) injured, destroyed, BhP.
परि-रटन n. (√ रट्) the act of crying or screaming, W.
परि-√ रिह् P. -रिहति, to lick or gnaw on all sides, RV. i, 140, 9 (cf. परि-लिह्).
परि-रिप्सु mfn. (fr. Desid.) wishing to embrace, Hariv.
परि-रिप्सु See परि-रभ्.
परि-रोध m. obstructing, keeping back, resistance, Rājat.
परि-√ 2. रुध् (only ind.p. -रोधम्, TBr., -रुध्य, Kpr.), to enclose, obstruct, keep back, hinder.
परि-√ रुच् Ā. -रोचते, to shine all around, BhP.
परि-रुद्ध mfn. obstructed by, filled with (comp.), R.
परि-√ रुज् P. -रुजति, to break from all sides, AV. xvi, 1, 2.
